fact: On 2 August 2023 the Prime Minister launched at Kati an AGEFAU-financed (about 10 billion FCFA) project giving collectivités territoriales their own private telecommunications network, initially 20 governorates and the Ministry of Territorial Administration, extendable to prefectures and sub-prefectures.
title: Mali : Un réseau de télécommunications privé pour les collectivités territoriales
